# Cacapon whole-course terrain source

One locked native-1m USGS tile: **USGS 1 Meter 17 x73y438 MD_Western_2021_D21**.
Acquisition: 2021-12-04 to 2021-12-21.
Retrieved: 2026-09-13. Immutable hashes and exact projected bounds
are in source-manifest.json and export.json. Do not replace the cached raster.

The EPSG:32617 export is sampled at approximately 1m; the 2m canonical
metric grid, 4m tactical mesh, 2m detail cells and coarser outer cells are separate
render/query choices, not claims of finer source resolution. Heights remain
NAVD88 meters. Registration residual and source vertical accuracy are unknown.

Neighbor source features are renderer-only context. No cart paths, rough
classification, additional tree areas, daily tee markers or cup positions are
created. Canopy evidence remains limited to the existing reviewed hole7 groups.

[USGS 3DEP products and use terms](https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program/about-3dep-products-services).
Source geometry attribution remains © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0.
